entities.summary: Former state in libya, ruled by muammar gaddafi; jamahiriya (“peopledom”) is a neologism by gaddafi (portmanteau of jamāhīr “the masses” + jumhūriyya “republic”) Located in Libya. Founded 1977. Population: 6,365,563.
